name: Annie Browning
abstract_title: GAZE™ as a Non-Pharmacological Altered-State Protocol for Transpersonal Leadership: A Program Evaluation Integrating EEG, fNIRS, and Psychometric Shifts
abstract: This program evaluation examined GAZE™, a non-pharmacological altered-state induction method designed to support transpersonal leadership capacities in high-performing adults. Over a seven-day immersive program, participants completed six structured sessions integrating high-ventilation breathwork with sequential closed-eye gaze patterns. All data were aggregated, de-identified program metrics collected for operational improvement; no individual-level human-subject research was conducted. Across
field: Altered states of consciousness, transpersonal psychology
notable: Developer of the GAZE protocol for expanded state induction without psychedelics.
